title: UK Competition Regulator Opens Antitrust Probe Into Meta Over AI Content Terms

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The UK's competition watchdog has launched an inquiry into whether Meta utilized unfair commercial agreements to obtain content from publishers and advertisers for its artificial intelligence training. The probe specifically examines if the company forced partners to accept terms that allow Meta to develop its AI services using third-party website data without providing an option to opt out.

The antitrust investigation centers on allegations that these commercial terms are "exploitative." The regulator is seeking to determine if the proposed terms for AI data usage deprived content creators of a meaningful choice regarding how their intellectual property is used to build Meta's AI tools.
